observations: body L1-L3: the end of the commentary c) begun on p. 306. P. 131, L4 of the translation leaves out the fixed stars («fixae, ob tardum suum motum, nec per applicationem planetis nec per proiectionem radiorum»), as printed.

body L4-L8: the dash after «d)» measures 9.7 pt and the dash of «20–38» (5.0 pt) is a long dash; the dash after «I.» measures 10.2 pt. The minus sign that begins L8 is printed as a dash (10.6 pt) and is set as a minus sign. The projection of the trine is 180° less that of the sextile, since AS + SB = 180° (p. 306, L29), as printed.
body L9-L12: «Albatenium» is letter-spaced. The second o of «modo» (L10) prints broken, and an ink spot stands within «trigonometricas».

body L13-L17: «Albatenii» (L13) is letter-spaced, and «22–23» has a long dash (5.2 pt). P. 131, L22-L23 of the translation read «est chorda integra secundi lateris, quod tantum in capite de diagonalibus quadrilaterorum [cap. XXVI] et in hoc capite ipso, in quo sumus, memoravimus». The figure of the right spherical triangle (the hypotenuse 60°, the latitude β, the arc x of the ecliptic) stands on the right of L13-L16, redrawn from the print: its sides are slightly curved (fitted with parabolas, rms 0.04 to 0.16 pt) and meet in sharp corners, the right angle is marked by two small arcs, and 60° and 90° are turned along the sides (10° and −25°). The minus sign of L17 is printed as a dash (9.6 pt).

body L18-L25: the rule of chapter XXVI (rule (α) of p. 202: the square of the chord of the distance is the product of the chords of the first and second sides with the square of the chord of the third side added) gives, for the distance 60°, the rule of L21. The second side has the chord crd x cos β/R, so that L23 follows. With chords, sines and cosines to the radius R, crd² a = 2R (R − cos a), and (α) reads R − cos x = R (cos β − cos 60°) : cos β, that is cos 60° = cos β cos x : R, the rule of the right spherical triangle: the formula is right. The bar of x/2 (L19) did not print, and the bar of cos β/R prints broken. The minus signs of L21, L23 and L25 are printed as dashes (9.2 to 9.6 pt) and set as minus signs. The 60 of (α) (L25) is printed without the degree sign.

body L26-L36: «al–Battānī» (L26, L28) is letter-spaced, with long dashes (5.3 and 5.2 pt); the o of «existimo» (L26) prints broken. The restored rule takes the words of p. 131, L21-L24 of the translation: for «nam hic semper est» it has the words in brackets of L29-L30, «[cap. XXVI]» is left out and «in hoc ipso capite» stands for «in hoc capite ipso»; the omissions are marked by five dots each (L32, L33, L35). 3600p is the square of 60p, the chord of 60°, which equals the radius, as printed.
notes_left L1-L2: the dash of «al-Battānī» (L1) measures 4.2 pt, the length of the hyphens of the notes, and is transcribed as a hyphen; «Ibn Yūnus» is letter-spaced. The place is p. 306, L30-L33.
notes_right L1-L2: the correction is that of Nallino's addenda (Part I, p. LXXIII), recorded on p. 202 (L21-L22, L24). The bar of the second fraction (L2) prints only in part.
